title.value: Morphological Parameters and Associated Uncertainties for 8 Million Galaxies in the Hyper Suprime-Cam Wide Survey
title.justification: The title is taken directly from the paper itself and accurately reflects its content concerning the study of galaxy morphological parameters using a machine learning framework.
title.quote: Morphological Parameters and Associated Uncertainties for 8 Million Galaxies in the Hyper Suprime-Cam Wide Survey

extractions.description: The paper presents GaMPEN, a machine learning framework that estimates morphological parameters and their uncertainties for about 8 million galaxies in the Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) Wide survey. GaMPEN employs Bayesian posteriors for parameters like bulge-to-total light ratio, effective radius, and flux. The approach involves training with simulated galaxies and transfer learning with real data, providing significant improvements over traditional methods. The paper’s methods are poised for use in upcoming large imaging surveys.
